text:
emma: Lucas from BrightWorks reports invoice higher than dashboard CSV. CSV shows 29,400 tokens for 2026-03-24 but billing page charged 22,100 after credits. Can we confirm which is source-of-truth? Org: brightworks-88
nikhil: On it. Ask customer for org_id and the raw CSV/JSON export. Did they run streaming sessions or an embeddings batch?
lucas_corp: org_brightworks_88. We attached the CSV: `2026-03-24,requests=210,total_tokens=29400,csv_shows=29400`. Billing summary shows charged=22100, credits_applied=8000. We assumed CSV would be net of credits.
hannah: Free credits are applied on the billing post-process; the CSV used by the UI historically shows gross token counts. We're working on a flag to display net_tokens in the CSV but not all frontends have it yet.
nikhil: Also quick audit: our request logs show a retry storm around 11:12-11:25 UTC with ~900 extra hits for this org. Retries are billable unless idempotency was used. Pulling request-ids now.
lucas_corp: We did get 429s from a third-party SDK and the SDK retried automatically. We believed retries were filtered.
hannah: Clarification: retries reaching ingestion increment usage and appear in gross CSV; credits reduce invoice amount but don't change raw counts. That explains the discrepancy. We'll provide corrected CSV with a net_tokens column and the billed line items.
notify-bot: (automated) Billing snapshot org_brightworks_88: month_estimate=$980, credits_remaining=$0 after this invoice, alert_threshold=$500, webhooks_enabled=false.
nikhil: Action items: 1) Send Lucas corrected CSV that includes net_tokens and line-by-line charged request-ids (ETA 2h). 2) Explain retry billing and recommend idempotency keys. 3) Sales to enable webhook alerts for this account as a temporary measure.
emma: I'll enable a temporary webhook->Slack forward for BrightWorks and escalate a small courtesy credit request for the POC if the retries came from the SDK.
hannah: I'll confirm billing: invoice matches final_token_count and no overcharge occurred; credits were applied on settlement. If sales approves credit, billing-ops will issue it and update S-90145.
lucas_corp: Thanks, please include the list of request-ids that were billed. We need to reconcile with our SDK logs.
nikhil: Will attach request-ids and mark which were billed vs CSV-only artifacts. Technical note: CSV bug tracked ENG-7951, fix will replace raw_stream_chunk sums with final_token_count.
emma: Closing loop: I'll DM Lucas once the corrected CSV and webhook are live. :thumbsup:
